title: Software Engineer III
description:
Top 3 habilidades técnicas obrigatórias: Desenvolvimento de APIs RESTful e microsserviços, frameworks JavaScript e banco de dados SQL/Postgres


Visão geral da posição

Como Engenheiro(a) de Software Principal na equipe de Administração de Membros dentro das soluções de Arquitetura, Engenharia e Construção da Autodesk, você será responsável por orientar a equipe de engenharia e liderar o design técnico para construir funcionalidades que preparem nossos clientes para o sucesso no Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC).

A equipe de Administração de Membros é responsável por fornecer aos clientes do ACC ferramentas para gerenciar usuários e permissões de hubs e projetos. Trabalhamos diretamente com nossos clientes para oferecer soluções para alguns de seus maiores desafios em gestão de construção. Você desempenhará um papel crítico em transformar essas soluções em realidade.

O ACC melhora a gestão da construção e capacita todos os construtores com equipes conectadas, fluxos de trabalho e dados por meio de uma plataforma onde os usuários podem interagir de forma fluida e eficiente ao longo de todo o ciclo de vida da construção. Nosso objetivo é economizar tempo eliminando redundâncias e oferecendo uma única plataforma que equipes inteiras podem usar para compartilhar informações de forma eficaz. Estamos construindo o futuro do software de construção.


Responsabilidades

  • Projetar, codificar, testar, depurar e documentar novas e existentes funcionalidades para garantir que a aplicação atenda às necessidades de negócio, qualidade e operação
  • Construir código robusto e de alta qualidade e estabelecer/manter altos padrões de qualidade e testes
  • Orientar membros da equipe sobre boas práticas de desenvolvimento de software
  • Interpretar e traduzir necessidades de negócio em requisitos técnicos e tarefas
  • Aplicar habilidades de resolução de problemas técnicos para projetar soluções de arquitetura seguras e escaláveis
  • Pesquisar e impulsionar a adoção de novas tecnologias
  • Identificar riscos e propor estratégias de mitigação relacionadas à arquitetura da aplicação
  • Participar ativamente de revisões de código e pull requests
  • Colaborar com diversas equipes dentro da ACS, tanto locais quanto internacionais
  • Atender, em regime de rodízio, incidentes críticos fora do horário comercial ou nos fins de semana para garantir disponibilidade 24/7 da plataforma


Qualificações mínimas

  • Mais de 8 anos de experiência em desenvolvimento de software e tecnologias web
  • Mais de 5 anos de experiência em produção com aplicações em infraestrutura de nuvem em larga escala
  • Experiência avançada na construção de APIs RESTful, microsserviços e interfaces front-end
  • Experiência avançada com frameworks JavaScript (Node.js, React)
  • Experiência avançada com SQL/Postgres
  • Forte conhecimento em AWS e arquiteturas em nuvem
  • Experiência sólida com ferramentas de manutenção e monitoramento de aplicações
  • Experiência sólida na criação de automações e pipelines de CI/CD
  • Experiência liderando uma equipe de pelo menos 3 engenheiros de software
  • Familiaridade com Docker para criação de aplicações containerizadas
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e capacidade de se comunicar com diferentes públicos, incluindo gerentes de produto, clientes e engenheiros de software
  • Curiosidade para entender e analisar problemas, pensar criticamente e propor soluções
  • Habilidade de colaboração remota em equipes distribuídas
  • Flexibilidade diante de mudanças e capacidade de gerenciar múltiplos projetos
  • Paixão por crescimento, aprendizado e mentoria


Software de gestão de construção que serve como sua única fonte de verdade para cada projeto.

Saiba como o Autodesk Construction Cloud pode ajudar suas equipes a colaborar com segurança e rapidez em todas as fases do projeto, permitindo entregas dentro do prazo e do orçamento.

title: Product Owner Sênior
description:
Estamos em busca de um Product Owner Sênior para liderar a evolução de produtos digitais no segmento de saúde, com forte proximidade das rotinas médicas, jornadas de consulta, fluxos clínicos e necessidades reais dos médicos e times assistenciais.

Esse profissional será responsável por atuar como elo entre negócio, tecnologia, usuários e stakeholders, garantindo que as decisões de produto gerem valor para a operação, melhorem a experiência dos profissionais de saúde e pacientes, e sustentem os objetivos estratégicos da organização.


O perfil ideal combina sólida experiência em produto com capacidade de entender a dinâmica do ambiente de saúde, especialmente a lógica por trás de consultas médicas, documentação clínica, jornadas assistenciais, gargalos operacionais e usabilidade para o médico no dia a dia.

Principais responsabilidades


  • Gerenciar e priorizar o backlog do produto, garantindo alinhamento com os objetivos do negócio e as necessidades dos usuários.
  • Traduzir objetivos estratégicos em requisitos claros, épicos, histórias de usuário e critérios de aceitação.
  • Atuar em parceria com stakeholders das áreas de saúde, operação, negócio, tecnologia, UX e dados.
  • Entender e mapear fluxos ponta a ponta do ambiente de saúde, incluindo consultas, agendamentos, prontuários, documentação clínica e rotinas de apoio ao médico.
  • Levantar necessidades diretamente com usuários, especialmente médicos, equipes clínicas e times operacionais.
  • Identificar dores nas rotinas médicas e administrativas, transformando essas necessidades em oportunidades de produto.
  • Priorizar funcionalidades com base em valor de negócio, impacto para o usuário, viabilidade técnica e urgência.
  • Participar ativamente das cerimônias ágeis, apoiando o time com direcionamento funcional e esclarecimento contínuo de requisitos.
  • Garantir que o produto entregue eficiência operacional, boa usabilidade, adoção e resultados mensuráveis.
  • Conduzir ou apoiar atividades de discovery, como entrevistas, análise de fluxos, validações e testes de hipótese.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com times de engenharia e design para construir soluções práticas e centradas no usuário.
  • Acompanhar indicadores de desempenho do produto, métricas de uso, feedbacks e resultados operacionais.
  • Promover a melhoria contínua dos produtos, equilibrando necessidades regulatórias, operacionais e de experiência do usuário.
  • Atuar como principal referência da squad em decisões de escopo, priorização e direcionamento funcional.


Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Experiência comprovada como Product Owner, Product Owner Sênior ou função equivalente em produto.
  • Vivência sólida em ambientes ágeis, com atuação junto a squads multidisciplinares.
  • Experiência no segmento de saúde, healthtech, operações clínicas, sistemas médicos ou contextos correlatos.
  • Forte compreensão de fluxos de saúde, especialmente relacionados a consultas médicas, rotina do médico, agendamentos, jornada do paciente e necessidades assistenciais.
  • Capacidade de compreender o que o médico precisa em termos de sistema, processo e usabilidade, mesmo quando a demanda não vem totalmente estruturada.
  • Experiência na escrita de histórias de usuário, definição de critérios de aceitação e gestão estruturada de backlog.
  • Habilidade de relacionamento e gestão de stakeholders.
  • Capacidade de conectar estratégia de negócio com execução de produto e entrega de tecnologia.
  • Perfil analítico, com capacidade de usar dados, evidências e feedbacks para apoiar priorização e tomada de decisão.
  • Capacidade de atuar em ambientes complexos, com múltiplos stakeholders e mudanças de prioridade.


Requisitos desejáveis

  • Experiência prévia com produtos relacionados a: prontuário eletrônico,
  • agendamento de consultas, telemedicina, otimização de fluxo clínico, portais médicos, jornada do paciente, coordenação do cuidado, plataformas assistenciais.
  • Familiaridade com requisitos regulatórios, privacidade e compliance no setor de saúde.
  • Experiência com integrações entre sistemas de saúde e interoperabilidade.
  • Vivência com médicos, clínicas, hospitais, centros diagnósticos ou operações assistenciais.
  • Experiência com discovery e desenho de serviços em contexto de saúde.
  • Conhecimento de métricas relacionadas à eficiência clínica, fluxo de atendimento, adoção e performance operacional.


Competências esperadas

  • Forte senso de dono sobre o produto
  • Excelente capacidade de priorização
  • Visão de negócio com foco no usuário
  • Capacidade de lidar com ambiguidade e transformar demandas em backlog acionável
  • Escuta ativa e boa facilitação
  • Empatia com médicos, pacientes e equipes operacionais
  • Comunicação clara com públicos técnicos e não técnicos
  • Pensamento estruturado para solução de problemas
  • Tomada de decisão orientada a valor e impacto
  • Alto nível de autonomia e accountability


O que esperamos de sucesso nessa posição


  • O roadmap do produto reflita prioridades reais do negócio e da operação em saúde.
  • Médicos e usuários clínicos percebam que o produto apoia, e não dificulta, a rotina do dia a dia.
  • Os requisitos estejam claros o suficiente para permitir execução eficiente pelo time de tecnologia.
  • As entregas gerem ganhos concretos de eficiência, qualidade operacional, adoção e experiência do usuário.
  • A squad tenha clareza sobre prioridades, contexto e objetivos de negócio.


Diferencial importante

Buscamos alguém que não apenas conheça produto, mas que tenha sensibilidade para entender a lógica do ambiente médico, conseguindo traduzir necessidades assistenciais e operacionais em soluções digitais de alto valor.

title: Senior Software Engineer (Python, Kafka, Kubernetes)
description:
DomainTools is hiring a Senior Software Engineer to join our Engineering Team. This role is perfect for a creative problem-solver with deep expertise in large-scale data engineering and a passion for technical leadership and continuous improvement. You'll be a key technical collaborator, not only designing and maintaining complex systems but also accelerating engineering productivity and mentoring the next generation of engineers.

We are looking for someone with a strong background in Python, Rust, GoLang, and cloud infrastructure (AWS, Docker, Kubernetes) who is eager to take on big challenges and deliver high-quality, impactful results.


Job Responsibilities

  • Design, code and maintain web-scale data systems
  • Discover, analyze and validate new data sets to add value for our customers
  • Creative problem solving to necessarily complex systems
  • Research, prove and employ cutting edge techniques & technologies
  • Provide code reviews, design feedback, demos, technical requirements & documentation
  • Provide accurate, scope, estimates for time, capacity & costs of projects
  • Improve the lives of your coworkers by accelerating engineering productivity, reducing operational toil and increasing consistency
  • Provide technical leadership, assist in on-boarding & mentoring of junior engineers


Key Applicant Qualifications

  • 3+ years of professional development experience with Python, GoLang, Rust or equivalent languages. Expertise in Rust and Python is highly valued.
  • 3+ years of experience with cloud infrastructure, specifically AWS, Docker, and Kubernetes.
  • 3+ years of experience with web-scale data engineering, leveraging data stores such as OpenSearch, Postgres (or PSQL), CockroachDB and Spark.
  • 3+ years of professional experience with Kafka.
  • 5+ years of experience working with Linux/Unix environments.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Proven ability to coordinate effectively between multiple teams.
  • A positive attitude, strong interpersonal skills, and a genuine enjoyment of collaborating with, mentoring and assisting teammates.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and a commitment to delivering high-quality results.
  • Demonstrated history of high initiative and productivity that consistently adds value.
  • A proactive attitude towards continuous learning, particularly in unfamiliar domains.
  • Excited and passionate about working within the security space.


Pluses

  • Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science/related field or equivalent experience
  • Design, implementation and/or maintenance of CICD & microservices
  • Experience with Data Pipelines such as ElasticSearch, NATS or Apache Airflow

description:

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Esta posição tem papel estratégico na liderança das operações logísticas e do planejamento de demanda, sendo responsável por transformar a área de logística de um modelo transacional para um modelo estratégico. Atuará na definição e implementação da estratégia logística, otimização de fluxos inbound e outbound, gestão de fornecedores críticos e integração com áreas-chave do negócio, garantindo eficiência operacional, competitividade de custos e suporte ao crescimento da empresa.

  • Experiência com sistemas ERP, como SAP e/ou Totvs;
  • Vivência tanto no lado cliente quanto fornecedor em operações logísticas (ex.: portos, freight forwarders – exceto despachante aduaneiro);

Quais serão suas responsabilidades?

  • Desenvolver e implementar a estratégia de logística e supervisionar as atividades de todas as equipes logísticas.

  • Monitorar e controlar os níveis de estoque.
  • Assegurar conformidade com as regulamentações de transporte e comércio internacional.
  • Desenvolver, implementar e acompanhar KPIs de logística, contribuindo para iniciativas de melhoria contínua nos processos logísticos.
  • Conduzir e liderar projetos de melhoria contínua.
  • Elaborar Mapas de Fluxo de Valor (Value Stream Maps) e coordenar iniciativas Kaizen.
  • Transformar o departamento de Logística de transacional para tático e, posteriormente, de tático para estratégico.

title: Billing Analyst
description:
About the Role We are hiring a Billing Analyst (Contracts & Invoicing) to support a high-volume, enterprise B2B billing operation within the telecommunications industry. This role owns the contractual and invoicing control stages of the Order-to-Cash process, acting as a quality, compliance, and accuracy gate between approved Purchase Orders and customer invoices. The position requires strong ERP execution, billing governance, and cross-functional organization.


Key Responsibilities

  • Execute and control the Contracts & Invoicing stages of the Order-to-Cash process.
  • Validate sales orders and invoices against Purchase Orders (POs), contracts, pricing references, and billing structures.
  • Create, update, and validate Sales Orders in ERP systems.
  • Prepare and review invoice drafts, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and audit readiness.
  • Manage invoice issuance, correction, and cancellation workflows with full traceability.
  • Register invoices and supporting documentation in official repositories.
  • Submit or share invoices through customer portals and approved channels.
  • Coordinate with Sales, Contracts, Projects, PMO, Warehouse, and Finance to obtain required billing inputs.
  • Track invoice status, blockers, aging, and SLAs, ensuring disciplined follow-up.


Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Law, or related fields. Experience in Billing, Invoicing, Contract Administration, or Revenue Operations.
  • Strong knowledge of Order-to-Cash (O2C) processes.
  • Hands-on experience with ERP systems (TOTVS Protheus highly desirable).
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills (controls, reconciliations, reporting).
  • Working knowledge of indirect taxation and invoice compliance.
  • Professional proficiency in English.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in telecommunications, infrastructure, or technology services.
  • Exposure to enterprise or Tier-1 customers.
  • Familiarity with invoice submission portals, acceptance workflows, and billing SLAs.
  • Experience operating in high-volume, month-end driven environments.

title: Engenheiro de Dados - Júnior
description:
Engenheiro de Dados - Júnior

A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui.


Sobre a Rethink

Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital , ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala.


Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos.


Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado.

Diversidade e Inclusão

Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos . Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência .

Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente?

Qual será o seu papel?

Como Engenheiro de Dados Júnior, seu papel será crucial no apoio à construção e sustentação de pipelines de dados robustos e eficientes, principalmente no ambiente Databricks. Você será responsável por garantir a entrega contínua de dados transformados e governados, desde a ingestão até a disponibilização para consumo analítico. Sua atuação contribuirá diretamente para a qualidade, confiabilidade e acessibilidade dos dados, sendo um membro fundamental na equipe de engenharia de dados.


Como será seu dia a dia?

  • Apoiar a construção e sustentação de pipelines de dados no Databricks, utilizando notebooks, jobs e pipelines;
  • Garantir a entrega contínua das camadas Bronze, Silver e Gold dentro da arquitetura de dados;
  • Ingerir, transformar e disponibilizar dados para consumo analítico;
  • Criar e manter tabelas Delta e views para suporte a dashboards e análises;
  • Atuar com compartilhamento e consumo de dados via Delta Sharing;
  • Apoiar a governança de dados utilizando Unity Catalog, gerenciando catálogos, schemas e permissões;
  • Monitorar execuções de pipelines, identificar falhas e realizar troubleshooting;
  • Corrigir causas-raiz e propor melhorias de confiabilidade e performance;
  • Implementar e/ou apoiar validações de qualidade de dados;
  • Documentar pipelines, regras de negócio e a linhagem básica dos dados;
  • Colaborar com analistas, times de BI e áreas de negócio para entendimento de requisitos e evolução das entregas.


Para esta vaga, é essencial:

title: Cloudbees DevOps Engineer
description:
Cloudbees DevOps Engineer – Help Shape the Future of Continuous Delivery at a Global Financial Technology Leader!


Join a mission-critical engineering organisation at the heart of one of the world’s most influential financial messaging and payments platforms. Become part of a global DevOps Engineering Services team enabling modern software delivery, automation, and orchestration across a highly complex, secure, and fast-moving technology landscape. Supporting internal engineering teams across the enterprise, you’ll contribute to a mature and rapidly expanding initiative driving CI/CD/RO adoption - powering over 100+ applications and accelerating delivery excellence for teams primarily across the United States.


This is your opportunity to work inside a global organisation transforming the way software is built, released, and operated - while collaborating with senior engineers and DevOps experts across continents.


Your Role as a Cloudbees DevOps Engineer

As a DevOps Engineer within the DevOps Engineering Services team, you’ll help deliver internal tooling, automation, and release orchestration capabilities that empower hundreds of developers and application teams.

Working in a transversal function, you’ll support the rollout and optimisation of CloudBees Release Orchestration (RO) and CI/CD best practices, ensuring smooth adoption and consistent execution across the organisation. You'll contribute to a mature programme governed by senior engineers, with clear guidance, structured delivery, and high-impact outcomes across enterprise DevOps environments.


What You’ll Do

  • Support adoption of CI/CD and RO tooling across internal DevOps teams
  • Work closely with Senior Engineers to execute release orchestration onboarding tasks
  • Assist in scaling the enterprise adoption of CloudBees RO, Jenkins, CloudBees CI/CD
  • Enable best practices for Git workflows, artefact management (Nexus), and code quality (SonarQube)
  • Support SAST/DAST integration within secure delivery pipelines
  • Provide technical support to internal teams as they adopt enterprise DevOps tooling
  • Contribute to IaC and automation efforts using Python and Ansible Automation Platform
  • Support containerisation initiatives using Docker and OpenShift/Kubernetes
  • Collaborate in an Agile, DevSecOps-driven environment to standardise delivery processes
  • Ensure accurate documentation, repeatable execution, and alignment to engineering guidelines


What You Bring

  • 4+ years of DevOps engineering experience
  • Hands-on expertise with CI/CD tooling, ideally CloudBees.
  • Hands on experience with Jenkins, Git, Nexus, SonarQube
  • Experience with SAST/DAST tools
  • Practical development experience in Java/Maven or C++
  • Exposure to infrastructure automation using Python and Ansible
  • Knowledge of containerisation: Docker, OpenShift/Kubernetes
  • Strong understanding of Agile and DevSecOps principles
  • Excellent English communication skills (client teams are primarily US-based)
  • Ability to follow established engineering patterns and execute with precision

Why Join the Remobi Community

  • 100% remote B2B/freelance contracts
  • Access to a global network of top-tier engineering opportunities
  • Curated content, role alerts, and a supportive contractor community


Apply today: If you're ready to elevate software delivery excellence at scale and support a global CDRO transformation initiative - we want to hear from you!

title: Direct Response Creative Strategist
description:
Direct Response Creative Strategist (Meta Ads Focus)


Company:

Penrose Skin

Location: Fully Remote

Compensation: $50,000 to $72,000 USD per year + Performance Bonus Structure

Job Type: Full-time


The Opportunity

Own the creative engine behind a DTC brand currently spending nearly $700K per month on Meta Ads with a target to scale to $2-3M per month in ad spend this year. You will write the scripts, build the strategy, and drive the ads that take Penrose Skin to the next level. This is a high-impact role for an elite direct response creative strategist who operates with extreme autonomy, understands deep consumer psychology, and wants a direct line to the founders.


About Penrose Skin

We are a premium direct-to-consumer grooming brand known for luxury, pheromone-infused body butters inspired by designer fragrances. From a niche disruptor, we have grown rapidly through viral digital marketing into a highly sought-after grooming essential. With a strong DTC presence and ambitious product launches ahead, this role sits at the absolute center of our next phase of aggressive scaling.


What You Will Do

Scale the Account: Push our Meta ad spend from its current $700K per month toward $2-3M per month while maintaining or improving ROAS through relentless creative testing and iteration.

Deep Psychological Strategy: Build concepts based on deep customer personas and match specific marketing frameworks (unaware, problem-aware, solution-aware) to those personas and their desires.

High-Volume Output: Produce a high volume of quality concepts weekly, working seamlessly with our graphic designers and leveraging AI tools (like nanobanana pro) to build statics on your own.

Scientific Iteration: Run \"learnings\" on every single creative. Form a hypothesis, test it, analyze why it worked or failed, and iterate on the winners relentlessly.

UGC and Content Mastery: Build and improve systems to source UGC, brief creators, manage AI video creatives, and oversee the production of high-converting assets.


What We Are Looking For

Proven Scale: You have a documented track record of managing creative strategy for Meta ad accounts spending $500K+ per month and have helped scale ad spend to $1M+ per month.

Extreme Autonomy: You do not wait for instructions. You get things done, build systems, and take full ownership of the creative pipeline without being asked.

Psychology Expert: You deeply understand consumer awareness stages, emotional hooks, personas, and how to write copy that converts cold traffic for specific audience segments.

AI and Format Fluent: You are up-to-date with the latest AI tech for ad creation (statics, video, AI-generated content) and know how to design listicles, advertorials, and hybrid MOF/BOF ads.

Obsessive Learner: You are addicted to learning, improving, and analyzing data to beat your own control ads. You stay on top of every new tool and trend in the space.


Our Culture

We are not a corporate 9-to-5. We are a small, obsessive team that plays to win.

We believe discipline beats motivation, every single day. We go all in, execute relentlessly, and hold ourselves to excruciatingly high standards because great is simply not good enough. We take full responsibility for our results. No excuses, no blame, no waiting to be saved.

We stay focused. We eliminate distractions. We embrace resistance because the sword can only be forged under fire.

We are radically honest, delusionally optimistic, and deeply grateful, but never satisfied.

If that sounds exhausting, this is not for you. If it sounds like home, we want to talk.

description:
About Downtown Engineers

The ideal candidate is content-obsessed with a strong brand lens, someone who takes one idea and immediately sees multiple formats, narratives and distribution paths. Beyond producing content, you'll ensure that everything Downtown puts out communicates the brand clearly and consistently.

Must-haves

  • Fluent English (written and spoken)

  • Comfortable working with multiple channels and priorities without losing consistency
  • Experience with content marketing or B2B communication
  • Strong sense of brand consistency: you notice when messaging, tone or visuals feel off, you act on it. And you also proactively propose improvements


Nice-to-haves

  • Experience with SEO, content optimization or marketing automation tools

  • Role with direct business impact

title: Electrical Engineering Pod Lead - 72132
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


Job Overview:

An Electrical Engineering Pod Lead responsible for managing a small team creating simulation-based design problems used to train and evaluate advanced AI models. The role owns problem quality, reproducible environments, and coordination with AI researchers , and requires strong EE domain depth plus hands-on Python, Docker, and basic cloud skills to review and support the pod end-to-end.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Team Leadership
  • Lead and manage a pod of 4–8 Engineering Design Specialists by assigning tasks, reviewing deliverables, removing blockers, and mentoring on problem design, simulation rigor, and documentation.
  • Act as the main point of contact with AI research teams to translate model feedback into refinements, while running regular syncs, tracking progress, and reporting updates and risks to program leads.
  • Technical Oversight
  • Oversee and approve pod outputs, maintain reproducible Docker-based simulation environments, support cloud infrastructure for simulation/grading,
  • Develop and review Python automation/validation, and proactively resolve dependency, versioning, and reproducibility issues.
  • Problem Design (Individual Contribution)
  • Personally design a portfolio of high-difficulty electrical engineering problems in your chosen subdomain.
  • Set the quality bar and design philosophy for the pod through your own example submissions.


Electrical Engineering Subdomains:

You must have deep expertise in at least one of the following, with working familiarity across others being a strong plus:

  • Analog / Mixed-Signal IC Design — op-amp topologies, ADC/DAC design, noise analysis, layout-aware design, SPICE-level simulation.
  • Power Electronics — DC-DC converters, inverter design, magnetics sizing, thermal management, efficiency optimization.
  • RF / Microwave Engineering — filter design, impedance matching, S-parameter analysis, transmission line and antenna design.
  • Digital Systems / FPGA / ASIC — RTL design, timing closure, synthesis-aware design, hardware-software co-design.
  • Embedded Systems — microcontroller/DSP-based design, real-time constraints, peripheral interfacing, power budgeting.


Required Qualifications:

  • Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering or a closely related discipline.
  • At least 5 years of hands-on electrical engineering design experience, with a track record of owning designs from specification through validated implementation.
  • At least 1–2 years of experience in a technical lead, senior engineer, or team coordination role.
  • Proficiency with Python for scripting, automation, and simulation workflows.
  • Hands-on experience with Docker: building images, writing Dockerfiles, managing containerized environments.
  • Familiarity with at least one cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure) — comfortable running workloads, managing storage, and monitoring jobs.
  • Proficiency with at least one open-source EE simulation tool (e.g., ngspice, PySpice, Qucs, OpenEMS, scikit-rf, or similar).


Nice-to-Have:

  • Experience designing engineering coursework, exam problems, or design challenges at graduate level.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines or automated testing frameworks.
  • Exposure to LLM evaluation, AI benchmarking, or training data curation.
  • Cross-domain familiarity with Control Systems, Embedded/Robotics, or Power Systems.

Administrative

  • Manage the full onboarding process for new clients, ensuring all documentation, meetings, and follow-ups are completed accurately and on time.
  • Organize, maintain, and manage shared drives and digital files, ensuring proper document categorization, version control, and audit-ready internal documentation.
  • Perform basic website updates such as posting content or minor edits.

title: Senior Mobile Developer
description:
Senior Mobile Developer


Role Purpose

As a Mobile Developer Senior Developer you will be responsible for architecting and building high performance enterprise grade mobile applications within the Experience Engineering and Digital Emerging Tech portfolios. This role focuses on leveraging React Native and the Salesforce Mobile SDK to deliver offline first data rich applications for a global FMCG leader. You will integrate advanced capabilities like OpenCV for image processing and manage complex local data using Smart Store, ensuring a seamless mobile experience within a hyper scaler heavy application landscape.


Key Responsibilities

  • CrossPlatform Development: Design and develop robust mobile applications for iOS and Android using React Native
  • Salesforce Integration: Implement and customize mobile solutions using the Salesforce Mobile SDK ensuring seamless synchronization between mobile devices and Salesforce clouds
  • Offline Data Management: Architect Offline First capabilities using Smart Store DB, Salesforce SmartStore and SmartSync to manage complex local data persistence and synchronization
  • Computer Vision Integration: Implement image processing and computer vision features, eg shelf scanning asset recognition or document processing using OpenCV within the mobile environment
  • State Management: Manage complex application states and data flows using Redux or Redux Toolkit
  • Experience Engineering: Build highfidelity responsive UIs that provide superior user journeys for fieldforce users and consumers adhering to global brand standards
  • Version Control CI/CD: Manage source code branching strategies and pull requests using GitHub integrated with automated mobile build pipelines
  • Emerging Tech Pilots: Support Digital Emerging Technology initiatives by prototyping mobile first AIML features and integrating with hyper scaler hosted APIs eg GCP Vision AI
  • Senior Developer Specifics: Lead technical design for mobile modules perform rigorous code reviews, optimize app performance, memory battery and mentor junior developers in mobile best practices


Primary Skills Must-Have

  • Core Framework: Expert level proficiency in React Native JavaScriptTypeScript
  • Salesforce: Mobile Hands on experience with Salesforce Mobile SDK and Smart Store DB
  • State Management: Deep understanding of Redux for enterprisescale mobile apps
  • Computer Vision: Experience integrating OpenCV or similar CNative modules into React Native applications
  • Version Control: Advanced proficiency in GitHub workflows and Gitbased collaboration


Secondary Skills Good-to-Have

  • Native Modules: Ability to write Native Bridges in SwiftObjectiveC iOS or JavaKotlin Android
  • Hyperscaler Exposure: Experience connecting mobile apps to GCPAzure backend services Cloud Run App Services
  • Salesforce Platform: Familiarity with Apex SOQL and Salesforce Lightning Web Components LWC
  • Mobile Security: Knowledge of OAuth2 Certificate Pinning and secure local storage patterns
  • FMCG Domain: Understanding of retail execution van sales or fieldforce automation workflows

title: Engineering Design Specialist - 72123
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


Job Overview:

We are looking for experienced engineers with deep design expertise to create challenging, simulation-based design problems for training and evaluating advanced AI models. The role focuses on crafting realistic engineering design tasks where a model must make genuine trade-offs, size components, and iterate against physics-based simulators to meet competing specifications.



Key Responsibilities:

  • Design and validate simulation-based engineering problems that require true design reasoning, with clear constraints and optimization goals.
  • Deliver complete problem sets including reference solutions, near-miss variants, edge cases, and documentation, ensure appropriate difficulty with multiple failure modes, and collaborate with researchers to refine problems based on model performance.


Domain Tracks:

You should have deep design expertise in at least one of the followin g; expertise spanning multiple tracks is a strong plus.

  • Electrical & Computer Engineering — analog/mixed-signal IC design, power electronics, RF/microwave, digital system design, FPGA/ASIC, embedded systems.
  • Mechanical Engineering — structural/thermal/fluid system design, mechanism design, HVAC, vibration/dynamics, manufacturing process design.
  • Chemical Engineering — reactor design, process design and optimization, separation systems, transport phenomena, combustion and thermochemistry.
  • Control Systems — classical and modern control design, state estimation, nonlinear and robust control, system identification.
  • Materials / Nano — materials selection under constraints, microstructure-property design, thin-film and nanoscale device design.

We are looking for a Product/Marketing Analyst to work on configuring and managing offers and partners within our PRM (Partner Relationship Management) system, ensuring the efficient execution of initiatives requested by the operator Vivo and coordinating activities with internal departments.


RESPONSIBILITIES:


· Configure offers and partners in the PRM system.


· Receive, analyze, and manage requests for new initiatives (new offers, changes, or the addition of new partners) from Vivo.


· Create status presentations and reports to track the initiatives.


· Coordinate with internal departments such as Development, Support, and QA as needed.


· Perform functional testing of offers prior to launch, ensuring quality and compliance.


· Support communication and alignment with internal and external stakeholders.


REQUIREMENTS:


· Experience in digital product management or product marketing.


· Knowledge of partner management platforms or CRM.


· Ability to create clear and objective presentations and reports.


· Ability to coordinate between technical and business departments.


· Organization and attention to detail to ensure quality in deliverables.


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:


· Experience in the telecom sector or with B2B2C platforms.


· Familiarity with partner integration processes and offer configuration.


· Basic knowledge of functional testing and QA tools.


· Fluency in Spanish.



ABOUT THE COMPANY:


TIMWETECH, a Portuguese multinational, is a global provider of technology solutions, operating in 80 countries through 30 offices and serving our clients with a diverse portfolio organized into three vertical sectors: B2B2C Platform Services, Digital Marketing, and Fintech.

title: Data Engineer
description:
We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer to design, build, and optimize scalable data pipelines and analytics solutions on Azure Databricks. In this role, you will develop end-to-end ETL/ELT workflows using Databricks, PySpark and SQL, implement data quality and monitoring frameworks, and apply modern data architecture patterns (Delta Lake / Lakehouse / medallion).


You will collaborate closely with product owners and analytics teams to translate business requirements into robust technical solutions, ensuring performance, reliability, and cost efficiency. Experience with Azure services (ADLS, ADF, Azure SQL, Key Vault), Git-based development workflows, and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform/Ansible) is highly valued.


Fluent English and native Portuguese are required.

title: Operador(a) de máquinas
description:
Sobre nós:

Furukawa Electric LatAm, Furukawa Electric Fiber & Cable e OFS agora são Lightera

Lightera é mais do que um nome, é um compromisso com a criação de conexões mais brilhantes que moldam o futuro.


O nome Lightera combina as palavras light (luz) e era, simbolizando um novo capítulo iluminado pelo poder transformador da luz. Isso reflete nossas raízes na tecnologia de fibra óptica e nossa visão de liderar o caminho para um futuro mais brilhante e mais conectado.


A Lightera está com vagas abertas para Operador(a) de Máquinas e busca pessoas comprometidas, que gostem de desafios e desejem evoluir junto com a empresa.


Aqui, você fará parte de um ambiente industrial moderno, com foco em segurança, qualidade, melhoria contínua e desenvolvimento de pessoas.


Vaga: Operador(a) de Máquinas

Área: Fábrica de Cabos

Local: Cidade Industrial de Curitiba

Modelo de trabalho: Fixo

Horário: Turnos e/ou escala 3x3


REQUISITOS:

  • Ensino Médio completo;
  • Disponibilidade para atuar em turnos e/ou escala 3x3;
  • Residir em Curitiba ou Região Metropolitana, com fácil acesso à região da CIC;
  • Conhecimentos básicos de leitura e interpretação de instruções de trabalho e procedimentos operacionais;
  • Disponibilidade para realização de horas extras, quando necessário.


DIFERENCIAIS:

  • Experiência anterior como Operador(a) de Máquinas em ambiente industrial;
  • Curso de Mecânica Básica Industrial, Processos Industriais ou áreas correlatas;
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de melhoria contínua, como 5S, Kaizen, TPM ou Lean Manufacturing;
  • Experiência com controle de qualidade visual e/ou dimensional;
  • Vivência em empresas dos segmentos metalúrgico, elétrico ou de cabos/fibras ópticas.


ATRIBUIÇÕES:

  • Operar máquinas fixas nos processos de trefilação, binagem, reunião, extrusão de isolamento, capa e tubo, pintura de fibras e fracionamento de cabos ópticos e eletrônicos, conforme os padrões operacionais;
  • Realizar inspeções durante o processo produtivo, assegurando a conformidade dos produtos com as normas internas de qualidade;
  • Monitorar os parâmetros de processo, identificando desvios e comunicando a liderança quando necessário;
  • Abastecer as máquinas e organizar os materiais conforme o fluxo produtivo;
  • Atuar de forma ativa nos programas de Melhoria Contínua, contribuindo para a redução de custos, desperdícios e aumento da produtividade;
  • Aplicar diariamente os conceitos do Programa 5S;
  • Utilizar as ferramentas e métodos do Sistema de Produção da empresa para a identificação e solução de problemas;
  • Movimentar materiais utilizando paleteiras manuais ou elétricas, respeitando as normas de segurança;
  • Zelar pela organização, limpeza e conservação do posto de trabalho e dos equipamentos;


Faça parte de nossa missão de moldar o futuro da conectividade.

Execute and control the Contracts & Invoicing stages of the Order-to-Cash process.
Validate sales orders and invoices against Purchase Orders (POs), contracts, pricing references, and billing structures.
Create, update, and validate Sales Orders in ERP systems.
Prepare and review invoice drafts, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and audit readiness.
Manage invoice issuance, correction, and cancellation workflows with full traceability.
Register invoices and supporting documentation in official repositories.
Submit or share invoices through customer portals and approved channels.

Track invoice status, blockers, aging, and SLAs, ensuring disciplined follow-up. Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Law, or related fields. Experience in Billing, Invoicing, Contract Administration, or Revenue Operations.
Strong knowledge of Order-to-Cash (O2 C) processes.
Hands-on experience with ERP systems (TOTVS Protheus highly desirable).
Advanced Microsoft Excel skills (controls, reconciliations, reporting).
Working knowledge of indirect taxation and invoice compliance.
Professional proficiency in English. Preferred Qualifications
Experience in telecommunications, infrastructure, or technology services.
Exposure to enterprise or Tier-1 customers.
Familiarity with invoice submission portals, acceptance workflows, and billing SLAs.
Experience operating in high-volume, month-end driven environments. Our compensation package:

Contribute to the development of scalable FX infrastructure supporting global payments and settlement flows.

LATAM: BRL, MXN, COP, CLP, ARS

Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks

FX trading systems

Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.
Preferred Qualifications

Vision & Mission
OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a Pay Fi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain's "killer app," with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2 B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and Stable X, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

Sua missão é garantir o equilíbrio entre a identidade de moda athleisure e a viabilidade produtiva, atuando de forma estratégica para que cada modelo seja, simultaneamente, um objeto de desejo e uma solução técnica de alta performance.
Ele atua como o elo central entre o conceito criativo e o produto acabado, servindo como referência técnica e estética para o time.
II. Responsabilidades Principais Criação e Tradução de Design: Propor conceitos criativos, temas e cartelas de cores, traduzindo-os em desenhos técnicos e especificações detalhadas para a construção de calçados.
Pesquisa e Inovação em Materiais: Realizar pesquisas de tendências globais e comportamento do consumidor, focando na aplicação de materiais tecnológicos e tecidos sintéticos voltados para alta performance.
Desenvolvimento e Refinamento Técnico: Atuar diretamente com Sourcing e Fornecedores no desenvolvimento de fôrmas, solados e componentes, garantindo que a proposta estética original seja mantida durante o processo de prototipagem e provas de calce.
Interface Estratégica: Colaborar de forma integrada com as áreas de Produto, Comercial e Produção para assegurar que o design respeite a viabilidade técnica e as metas de margem do negócio.
Guardião da Identidade e Ergonomia: Garantir a consistência visual das linhas de calçados, zelando pela qualidade estética e pela ergonomia, assegurando que o produto final reflita o DNA da marca.
Análise de Evolução de Produto: Monitorar a performance de vendas e o feedback de mercado para retroalimentar o processo criativo com melhorias contínuas no mix de produtos.
III. Requisitos e Qualificações Experiência Profissional: Experiência consolidada atuando no ciclo completo de calçados (estilo e design técnico) em marcas de moda, sportswear ou acessórios.
Domínio Técnico-Criativo: Profundo conhecimento em processos de fabricação, materiais têxteis/sintéticos e habilidade técnica para leitura e criação de fichas e componentes.
Vivência em Chão de Fábrica: Experiência prática no acompanhamento de produção e desenvolvimento junto a fornecedores.
Habilidades Analíticas: Capacidade de traduzir o conceito da marca em produtos funcionais, equilibrando olhar apurado com as necessidades comerciais do mercado.
Formação: Graduação em Design de Produto, Moda, Design de Moda ou áreas correlatas.
IV. Diferenciais Experiência específica no desenvolvimento de sneakers ou calçados utilitários para o nicho Athleisure.
Capacidade de transitar com agilidade entre a criação artística e o rigor técnico do design.
Vivência em ambientes de alta escala com múltiplas coleções e fluxos dinâmicos de lançamento.
Conhecimento em análise de dados de mercado voltados especificamente para o setor de calçados.

title: Especialista de arquitetura e implantação | expansão
description:
Descrição da vaga No Azzas 2154 Fashion & Lifestyle, somos movidos por pessoas.
São elas que impulsionam ideias, constroem marcas e fazem a moda acontecer todos os dias.
Aqui, cada pessoa tem voz, espaço e responsabilidade na construção do que fazemos.
É assim, todos os dias, que nos tornamos o maior Grupo de Moda da América Latina.
Buscamos um perfil estratégico e multidisciplinar para atuar no coração da expansão do Grupo F&L.
Você será responsável por gerenciar a arquitetura e a implantação de lojas para diversas marcas do portfólio, garantindo que cada conceito criativo seja traduzido em espaços viáveis, rentáveis e escaláveis.
É uma posição de alta visibilidade, que exige trânsito entre o criativo e o financeiro, com foco em excelência operacional.
Responsabilidades e atribuições Desenvolvimento de Conceito Multimarca: Colaborar com os times criativos de cada marca (Reserva, Sprint, Oficina, etc.) para refinar conceitos arquitetônicos, garantindo que a execução seja fiel ao DNA de cada marca e economicamente viável.
Engenharia de Valor e Escalabilidade: Analisar criticamente os projetos para garantir que as soluções sejam escaláveis (rollout), definindo padrões técnicos que otimizem prazos e custos sem comprometer a estética.
Gestão de Implantação e Obras: Liderar o ciclo completo de obras e reformas de todo o portfólio do grupo, do planejamento inicial à entrega das chaves.
Interface Estratégica com Administradoras: Atuar como interlocutor técnico sênior junto aos grandes players de shopping ( Multiplan, Allos, Ancar, etc.
), negociando cadernos técnicos e prazos de aprovação.
Gestão de CAPEX e Parceiros: Equalizar orçamentos, realizar a precificação junto a parceiros estratégicos e garantir que cada inauguração respeite as metas financeiras do Grupo.
Homologação e Fiscalização: Selecionar e gerenciar fornecedores e empreiteiras, realizando visitas técnicas para garantir a qualidade de entrega e o cumprimento dos cronogramas.
Legalização: Coordenar os processos de obtenção de alvarás e licenças, garantindo a conformidade de todas as unidades do grupo.
Requisitos e qualificações Formação: Superior completo em Arquitetura e Urbanismo (preferencial) ou Engenharia Civil.
Experiência: Sólida bagagem em implantação de varejo, preferencialmente com experiência em gestão de múltiplas marcas simultâneas.
Bagagem de Mercado: Experiência em marcas que são referências em conceito e experiência de loja ou em grandes administradoras de shoppings é um diferencial importante.
Soft Skills Inegociáveis: * Comunicação e Articulação: Habilidade para escrever e falar com clareza, influenciando parceiros externos e reportando resultados para a liderança.
Autonomia e Proatividade: Perfil "dono do negócio", capaz de gerir múltiplos cronogramas e tomar decisões rápidas em cenários de obra.
Organização: Disciplina para gerenciar orçamentos e prazos de diferentes marcas ao mesmo tempo.
Ferramentas: Domínio de Auto Cad e Pacote Office (Excel avançado para controle de CAPEX).
Mobilidade: Residir no Rio de Janeiro e ter disponibilidade para viagens.
Informações adicionais NOSSOS BENEFÍCIOS No Azzas 2154 Fashion & Lifestyle, acreditamos que cuidar das pessoas é parte essencial para construir o maior Grupo de Moda da América Latina.
Por isso, oferecemos um conjunto de benefícios pensado para apoiar o bem-estar, o desenvolvimento e o dia a dia de quem faz parte da nossa história.
Saúde e bem estar • Plano de saúde • Plano odontológico • Seguro de vida • Programas de bem-estar físico, como Wellhub ou Total Pass • Iniciativas de apoio à saúde mental Dia a dia e qualidade de vida • Benefícios flexíveis por meio de cartão Flash • Vale transporte • Day off de aniversário • Extensão de licença maternidade • Extensão de licença paternidade • Descontos nas marcas do grupo Desenvolvimento e crescimento • Programas de capacitação e desenvolvimento • Trilhas de aprendizagem corporativas • Iniciativas de reconhecimento e engajamento Reconhecimento • Participação nos resultados, conforme política vigente * Os benefícios podem variar de acordo com o cargo, a unidade e as políticas internas da companhia.

title: Técnico em segurança
description:
KNOT is a Norwegian shipowner, the largest shuttle tanker operator in the world. As we manage our own fleet, contracts and crew, we give a unique development opportunity for our seafarers and employees. On top of that, we pride ourselves in being a company that values safety, innovation and growth for our employees.
Innovation, Credibility and Care are very important values for us.
This job opportunity is for a Safety Technician.
We are looking for professionals who are qualified, committed to joining our Brazil team, and who want to grow and collaborate with us and with our teams from around the world.
If you are hands-on, proactive and enjoy a challenge, join us!
Job challenges:
- Management of legal documents – PGR, PCMSO, ASO, LTCAT;
- Monitor, and enforce KNOT's HSEQ policies, procedures, and governing documentation;
- Monitor companyactivities to ensure compliance with regulatory, client, and internal HSEQ requirements;
- Ensure adherence to Brazilian Regulatory Standards (NRs) and applicable local legal requirements, supporting their correct application in the workplace;
- Manage the availability, distribution, and correct use of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE).
- Take part in investigations and analyses of work-related accidents, incidents, and near misses;
- Prepare technical reports, record findings, and communicate deviations, corrective actions, and lessons learned.
- Develop and support educational actions and safety campaigns related to occupational health and safety.
- Participate in HSEQ audits and inspections, both onshore and onboard vessels/facilities.
- Support internal and external inspections and follow up on action plans resulting from audits;
- Participate in emergency response drills and simulations;
- Support emergency response readiness and compliance with emergency procedures;
Requirements:
- Technical degree in Occupational Safety;
- Previous experience as an Occupational Safety Technician, preferably in the maritime/naval industry;
- Advanced English (frequent interaction with Norwegian colleagues and other cultures) – will be tested;
- Experience in the implementation of Brazilian Regulatory Standards (NRs);
- Intermediate Excel skills;
- Desirable: Bachelor's degree;
- Desirable: Experience with e Social system (Brazilian digital platform for labor, social security, and tax reporting).
Benefits we offer:
- Food allowance;
- Transportation allowance without discount;
- Health and dental plan at no cost;
- Life insurance;
- Private pension;
- Profit-Sharing;
- Well Hub Membership.
If you meet the requirements and are interested in being part of a company that values its professionals, offers development opportunities and an excellent working environment, apply now.
All our job openings are also available to people with disabilities.

title: Institutional relations manager
description:
Founded in 1948, Karadeniz Holding is a visionary industry leader that focuses on innovation while supporting growth with an emphasis on economic and environmental sustainability across a wide range of industries, primarily energy and shipbuilding.
Operating in more than 20 countries, with over 3,000 employees from 30 different nationalities and an installed capacity exceeding 8,000 MW, the Group generates reliable and clean electricity across four continents through its fleet of 45 Powerships TM and 11 LNG vessels, providing employment to more than 10,000 people worldwide. Karadeniz Holding manages its Powership TM fleet under its international brand Karpowership, meeting between 10% and 100% of the electricity needs of the countries where it operates across Europe, Africa, the Americas, and Asia. With high-capacity energy solutions, including Powership TM, land-based plants, and floating LNG infrastructure, Karpowership supports countries and companies in their energy transition processes.
We are looking for an Institutional Relations Manager to join our operations in Brazil, based at our Rio de Janeiro office.
WHAT DO WE EXPECT?
- Bachelor's degree in Law, Economics, Engineering, Business Administration or related fields; postgraduate degree or MBA will be considered a plus,
- Minimum of 8 years of experience in institutional, governmental, or regulatory affairs, preferably within the energy sector (power generation, natural gas, oil & gas, or infrastructure),
- Strong knowledge of the Brazilian regulatory environment, especially in the electricity and natural gas sectors, including interaction with entities such as ANEEL, ONS, and MME,
- Proven experience in managing relationships with key stakeholders (government, regulators, associations, and institutional partners),
- Advanced English (spoken and written),
- Strong communication, negotiation, and influencing skills in complex and multicultural environments,
- Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret regulatory scenarios and anticipate risks and opportunities,
- Leadership skills, project management capabilities, and ability to work cross-functionally,
- Ability to work under pressure, manage multiple priorities, and handle strategic topics,
- High ethical standards and alignment with compliance and corporate governance practices,
- Proactive profile with autonomy and ability to develop strategic and innovative solutions.
WHAT AWAITS YOU?
- Lead and execute KPS Brazil's institutional and governmental relations strategy, ensuring alignment with business and regulatory objectives,
- Develop and maintain strategic relationships with government bodies, regulators, and industry entities, including ANEEL, ONS, MME, IBAMA, and other relevant stakeholders,
- Continuously monitor and analyze the regulatory and institutional landscape of the electricity and natural gas sectors in Brazil, anticipating risks and opportunities,
- Proactively represent and defend the company's interests in public consultations, hearings, and regulatory forums,
- Coordinate licensing processes, authorizations, and institutional interactions required for project implementation, operation, and continuity (including Powerships and onshore assets),
- Structure and implement stakeholder engagement strategies at local, regional, and national levels, including governments, communities, and strategic partners,
- Support institutional and contractual negotiations with public authorities and regulatory bodies, ensuring legal compliance and risk mitigation,
- Work closely with legal, regulatory, commercial, and operational teams to ensure consistency in the company's institutional positioning,
- Manage institutional crises and sensitive matters, ensuring effective communication and strategic positioning,
- Lead the preparation of strategic reports and executive analyses on the regulatory and institutional environment to support senior leadership decision-making,
- Represent the company in industry associations, chambers of commerce, and energy sector forums, strengthening KPS's institutional presence in Brazil,
- Ensure compliance with corporate governance, ethics, and compliance guidelines in all institutional interactions.
WHAT DO WE OFFER?
- Hybrid working model,
- One day off on your birthday,
- Private health insurance (extended to dependents) and life insurance,
- Variable compensation package and performance-based bonus,
- Meal allowance + food allowance in line with market practices,
- Mobility benefits (transport allowance and parking policy),
- Well-being and quality of life programs, including Total Pass,
- Professional and personal training and development opportunities,
- Multicultural environment with exposure to international projects,
- Opportunity to contribute to strategic energy transition projects.
In line with our "One World" philosophy, we are adding success to our achievements with our colleagues, candidates, and all stakeholders. We are committed to providing equal opportunities for all applicants, regardless of race, religion, language or gender and we crown our success with our diversity.
In accordance with the Brazilian General Data Protection Law – LGPD (Law No. 13,709/2018), we kindly ask you to review our Privacy Notice for detailed information regarding the processing of your personal data.

title: Strategic partnership & alliance
description:
About Rate Gain
Rate Gain Travel Technologies Limited is a global provider of AI-powered Saa S solutions for travel and hospitality that works with 3,200+ customers and 700+ partners in 100+ countries helping them accelerate revenue generation through acquisition, retention, and wallet share expansion. Rate Gain today is one of the world’s largest processors of electronic transactions, price points, and travel intent data helping revenue management, distribution and marketing teams across hotels, airlines, meta-search companies, package providers, car rentals, travel management companies, cruises and ferries drive better outcomes for their business.
Founded in 2004 and headquartered in India, today Rate Gain works with 26 of the Top 30 Hotel Chains, 25 of the Top 30 Online Travel Agents, 4 of the Top 5 Airlines, and all the top car rentals, including 16 Global Fortune 500 companies in unlocking new revenue every day.Exploring the role
Rate Gain is privileged to partner with hotels of every size and type around the world to achieve their commercial objectives – from independent, luxury, lifestyle, and boutique hotels, to the world’s largest chains. Chains - and multi-site operators - have unique business requirements, additional complexity, and often use more diverse technology solutions. As a partner of choice for global and regional chains, Rate Gain is looking to further serve this important segment of the hospitality industry and seeks an experienced Director focused on European markets, to further scale this essential unit of our business.
The ideal candidate will understand how Latam hotel chains function and operate, and will be familiar with the technology solutions adopted by these chains to achieve their commercial objectives. The role requires a trusted advisor, able to assist chains to manage through the complexities of the travel technology eco system to guide them to the right decisions in the areas of distribution, business intelligence, marketing technologies, and beyond.
This is an individual contributor role and, as such, the candidate is expected to be a self-started and self-driven, ready to innovate to find new values for our hotel chain clients whilst keeping the company goals and the bigger picture firmly in mind. This position can be based anywhere in Latam and needs to have the ability to travel within the Latam without limitations.How your day will look like/Job responsibility
Build and manage strategic alliances with regional and local partners (e.g. RMS, PMS, booking engines, OTAs)
Define and execute a partnership roadmap aligned with Rate Gain’s GTM strategy in LATAM
Identify co-marketing, co-selling, and integration opportunities with key players in the hospitality and travel ecosystem
Collaborate with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Product, Legal) to structure and execute partnership agreements
Represent Rate Gain in industry events and partnership meetings to promote our brand and solutions
Monitor partner performance, engagement, and contribution to pipeline and revenue
Provide regular reporting and insights on partnership outcomes and market trendsEducation & Work Experience
Bachelor’s degree in business, Marketing, or a related field
5+ years of experience in business development or strategic partnershipsKnowledge:
In-depth understanding of the LATAM hospitality and travel technology ecosystem
Knowledge of Saa S business models and partnership structures
Awareness of regional trends, customer behavior, and competitive landscape in the travel and hospitality sectorsSkills:
Strong negotiation and deal-closing capabilities
Excellent relationship management skills with ability to engage partners at all levels
Advanced verbal and written communication skills inSpanish, Portuguese, and English
Ability to identify, pitch, and convert strategic partnership opportunities
Proficiency in using CRM and sales enablement tools
Skilled in cross-functional collaboration with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Legal, Product, etc.)Attitude:
Proactive and results-oriented, with a strong drive to exceed targets
Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for growth and innovation
Culturally sensitive and collaborative, with the ability to work effectively in a global, remote team
High level of integrity, professionalism, and ownership
Resilient and adaptable in a fast-paced and evolving environment

title: Consultor(a) de investimentos associado(a)
description:
Se você já atua no mercado financeiro e procura a melhor estrutura para atender seus clientes sem conflito de interesses, com boas perspectivas de carreira e sendo bem remunerado, essa vaga é para você!
Somos uma consultoria de investimentos que atende famílias em busca do crescimento patrimonial e da preservação do legado. Atendemos clientes em todos os grandes bancos e corretoras do Brasil e também nos EUA. Nosso modelo de atuação é 100% FEE BASED sem conflito de interesses.
ALOCAÇÃO: Somos associados ao grupo Nord Investimentos garantindo que as melhores estratégias de alocação estarão à disposição dos seus clientes, ou seja, você terá relatórios e calls de investimento independentes e de alta qualidade.
INDEPENDÊNCIA: Trabalhamos com todos os bancos no Brasil e temos integração com 3 instituições americanas (Morgan Stanley, Interactive Brokers e Avenue), ou seja, onde quer que seu cliente esteja, você poderá atendê-lo.
EXPERIÊNCIA: Temos um time experiente e com metodologia proprietária que ajuda na conversão de leads (90%) e retenção de clientes (churn menor que 0,50% ao ano).
CARREIRA: Nosso programa de partnership garante que você tenha oportunidade de aumentar sua participação societária no nosso grupo empresarial na medida em que seus resultados e contribuições cresçam. Nossa empresa também possui uma corretora de seguros completa (Monte Bianco Insurance) e uma área com soluções Corporate que atende PJ com empréstimos, cambio, energia e antecipação de recebíveis. Ou seja, aqui você pode oferecer uma oferta completa de produtos e serviços para seus clientes.
Essa proposta de valor em conjunto com nossa metodologia exclusiva tem resultado em mais de 90% de taxa de conversão de leads em clientes.
Estamos em busca de profissionais experientes da área de investimentos para ampliar a equipe da Monte Bianco Multi-Family Office (MBM) no Rio de Janeiro. Este cargo demanda a realização de recomendações financeiras especializadas, gerenciamento de carteiras de investimento e interação contínua com clientes para entender suas necessidades e objetivos financeiros. As responsabilidades diárias incluem análise de tendências de mercado, identificação de oportunidades de investimento e fornecimento de um serviço ao cliente de alta qualidade.
Qualificações
Investimentos e Finanças: necessário ter experiência prévia em atender clientes no mercado financeiro.
Relacionamento: garantir que as necessidades dos clientes sejam compreendidas e atendidas de maneira eficaz.
Prospecção: captação ativa de novos leads e desenvolvimento da estratégias para conversão Caso o candidato não possua nenhuma das certificações exigidas (CEA/CFP/CNPI), será concedido um prazo de 6 meses para que consiga se certificar.

title: Técnico em segurança
description:
KNOT is a Norwegian shipowner, the largest shuttle tanker operator in the world.
As we manage our own fleet, contracts and crew, we give a unique development opportunity for our seafarers and employees.
On top of that, we pride ourselves in being a company that values safety, innovation and growth for our employees.
Innovation, Credibility and Care are very important values for us.
This job opportunity is for a Safety Technician.
We are looking for professionals who are qualified, committed to joining our Brazil team, and who want to grow and collaborate with us and with our teams from around the world.
If you are hands-on, proactive and enjoy a challenge, join us! Job challenges: - Management of legal documents – PGR, PCMSO, ASO, LTCAT; - Monitor, and enforce KNOT’s HSEQ policies, procedures, and governing documentation; - Monitor company activities to ensure compliance with regulatory, client, and internal HSEQ requirements; - Ensure adherence to Brazilian Regulatory Standards (NRs) and applicable local legal requirements, supporting their correct application in the workplace; - Manage the availability, distribution, and correct use of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE).
- Take part in investigations and analyses of work-related accidents, incidents, and near misses; - Prepare technical reports, record findings, and communicate deviations, corrective actions, and lessons learned.
- Develop and support educational actions and safety campaigns related to occupational health and safety.
- Participate in HSEQ audits and inspections, both onshore and onboard vessels/facilities.
- Support internal and external inspections and follow up on action plans resulting from audits; - Participate in emergency response drills and simulations; - Support emergency response readiness and compliance with emergency procedures; Requirements: - Technical degree in Occupational Safety; - Previous experience as an Occupational Safety Technician, preferably in the maritime/naval industry; - Advanced English (frequent interaction with Norwegian colleagues and other cultures) – will be tested; - Experience in the implementation of Brazilian Regulatory Standards (NRs); - Intermediate Excel skills; - Desirable: Bachelor’s degree; - Desirable: Experience with e Social system (Brazilian digital platform for labor, social security, and tax reporting).
Benefits we offer: - Food allowance; - Transportation allowance without discount; - Health and dental plan at no cost; - Life insurance; - Private pension; - Profit-Sharing; - Well Hub Membership.
If you meet the requirements and are interested in being part of a company that values its professionals, offers development opportunities and an excellent working environment, apply now.
All our job openings are also available to people with disabilities.

description:
Requisitos: -Desejável superior completo em Hotelaria ou cursando; -Necessário boa vivência com governança, hotelaria e higienização; -Necessário vivência com gestão de equipes e conhecimento de controle de enxoval.

- Realizar reuniões mensais com a empresa de terceirização de limpeza, com objetivo de demonstrar os resultados; - Garantir o preenchimento do SLA, juntamente com a supervisora da empresa terceirizada; - Controlar o fluxo de atividades e implantação de rotinas do setor; - Garantir a guarda segura do mobiliário do hospital e inventário do mesmo; - Coordenar a substituição dos móveis danificados ou sempre que houver a solicitação do responsável de cada setor do hospital; - Acompanhar o controle de indicadores operacionais referentes aos setores sob a sua responsabilidade; - Controlar e gerir banco de horas e escalas da equipe; - Acompanhar a realização do inventário de enxoval e analisar a necessidade de reposição e controle do mesmo; - Garantir, de maneira segura, a guarda de pertences; - Garantir o cumprimento correto de todos os procedimentos padrão do setor, de forma a garantir a qualidade do serviço prestado; - Acompanhar o controle de uniformes da unidade; - Acompanhar o desempenho e avaliação de qualidade percebida dos clientes, de acordo com a ferramenta HFocus..

- Escala de trabalho: 5x2 - 08h às 18h (segunda à sexta-feira).

title: Técnico de segurança do trabalho
description:
Atuar na prevenção de acidentes e doenças ocupacionais, garantindo um ambiente seguro e em conformidade com as normas legais (NRs). Inspecionar locais de trabalho, orienta sobre o uso de EPIs/EPCs, realizar treinamentos, investigar acidentes e elaborar documentos técnicos.
Principais Atividades e Responsabilidades:
Prevenção e Inspeção: Realizar vistorias diárias para identificar riscos, inspecionar máquinas, equipamentos e garantir o uso correto de EPIs (Equipamentos de Proteção Individual) e EPCs (Equipamentos de Proteção Coletiva).
Gestão de Riscos: Mapear riscos (físicos, químicos, biológicos, ergonômicos) e desenvolver planos de ação para mitigá-los.
Treinamentos e Cultura: Organizar e ministrar treinamentos sobre normas de segurança, prevenção de incêndios e primeiros socorros, promovendo uma cultura de segurança.
Documentação e Conformidade: Elaborar relatórios, laudos técnicos, investiga acidentes de trabalho para evitar repetições e assegura que a empresa cumpra a legislação trabalhista.
Apoio a Emergências: Coordenar planos de evacuação e atua diretamente em situações de emergência. Formação Necessária:
É preciso ter curso técnico em Segurança do Trabalho, e experiência comprovada em carteira, desejável em Industria.

title: Power platform developer
description:
POSITION TITLE: Microsoft Power Platform Developer (individual contractor 6 – 12-month term with the possibility of extension, remote in Brazil)
JOB OVERVIEW:
Working with our IT team to develop Power Platform solutions and provide technical support for the Power Platform systems. We are seeking a skilled Microsoft Power Apps Developer to join our dynamic IT team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, implementing, and supporting business applications using Microsoft Power Apps and Power Automate. This role requires a deep understanding of Power Platform, business process approval workflow, to create efficient and scalable solutions that meet our business needs.
JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:
• Design, develop and maintain Power Platform Applications (specifically Dynamics) and related components (e.g., Power Apps, Power Automate).
• Experience writing and maintaining Power Platform flows for automation and system efficiency.
• Build APIs and integrations to connect external systems and implement business logic and flows.
• Integrate Power Platform with other Microsoft services including Power BI, and Share Point.
• Collaborate with business stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
• Create and maintain documentation for developed applications and processes.
• Provide technical support and troubleshooting for Power Platform solutions.
• Conduct training sessions and workshops for end-users to ensure effective utilization of developed applications.
• Working remotely cover 4 hours of US Pacific time zone (between 9:00am – 5:00pm PST).
JOB QUALIFICATIONS:
• Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field.
• Proven experience in developing applications using Microsoft Power Platform.
• Strong knowledge of Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI and API.
• Experience with Microsoft Share Point, Microsoft Dynamics, and other Microsoft services.
• Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
• Strong communication and collaboration skills in English.
• Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
• Microsoft Power Platform certification is preferred.
WORK LOCATION:
Remote in Brazil
